defs.def: connected with a patent 有专利的；受专利保护的

ex.s: The Texas-based company has developed and patented scooping and lifting technology to move massive trees.
ex.t: 这家总部位于德克萨斯的公司开发并为搬运大树的技术申请了专利。

ex.s: The Wright brothers got their inspiration from observing pigeons in flight, and in 1903 successfully obtained a patent for their designs for the first aeroplane.
ex.t: 莱特兄弟从观察鸽子飞行中获得灵感，并于1903年成功获得了他们的第一架飞机设计的专利。

ex.s: After two years of looking for work as a teacher, Einstein took a job as a clerk in the Swiss patent office.
ex.t: 在找了两年教师工作后，爱因斯坦在瑞士专利局找了份文员的工作。

ex.s: After four years, he was able to quit his job at the patent office and enter research full-time at a university.
ex.t: 四年后，他得以辞去专利局的工作，在一所大学全职从事研究工作。

defs.def: made or sold by a particular company 产品
